column1: # PC-98 sound file <-> CD audio track of the FM Towns CD (1993) and of the Windows CD (1996; same recordings).
# Source: re-tools/evecmp.py (what each release starts at the same place of each script) and the sound tests
# (SOUND.MES / SOUND.EVE); docs/re/other-versions.md section 4. cd_track = disc track number (track 1 is data).
# start_sector / sectors: position in the Towns image (2352-byte sectors, 75 per second). loop: what the Windows
# scripts set before starting it (yes = repeat). pc98_uses: sound commands naming the file in the 118 PC-98 scripts.
